Thank you very much for this interesting talk. I work in a pain clinic in Ankara, and we see many patients with nerve damage after diabetes, not leprosy, but I think the mechanism is similar. My question is about your sample. You said you had sixty patients, but how many of them were women? Because in our clinic, women report much more pain than men, and we are not sure if this is biology, or if men simply do not talk about it. So, do you think gender could be a factor in your results, or did you not look at that?

Hello, yes, two quick questions from me. First, a practical one: where can we find your protocol? Is it published, or is it only on the poster? And second, maybe a more difficult one. You measured pain with a scale from zero to ten. But many of our patients cannot read, and they do not understand numbers very well. So how do you know that the patients understood the scale? Did you use pictures, faces, anything like that? Thank you.
